title: Poverty In India
definition: Poverty in India is defined as a condition where individuals lack the financial resources and essentials for a minimum standard of living, historically measured through caloric intake thresholds and currently via multi-dimensional deprivations.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for GS Paper III (Inclusive Growth, Poverty, Development) and Prelims (Economic and Social Development - committees, MPI indices, welfare schemes).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Poverty In India.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
